actions.name: upload_attachment
actions.title: Upload attachment
actions.description: Upload attachment to a sales record
actions.help: This action uploads an attachment to a sales record (e.g. invoice and receipt) in Xero. First, select the record type and provide ID of the record. Next, provide an attachment name content to be uploaded. Each sales record is limited to 10 attachments and each attachment is limited to 10MB.

input.name: record_ID
input.label: Record ID
input.hint: Upload an attachment to this record. This record must match the record type selected.

input.name: file_name
input.label: Attachment name
input.hint: Provide a name for this attachment. Include extension in the name (e.g. pdf, png, jpg).

input.name: content
input.label: Attachment content
input.hint: Contents of the attachment you want to upload. Size is limited to 10MB.

input.name: mime_type
input.label: Mime type
input.hint: MIME media type of the object being uploaded. Eg: image/jpeg . If no value is provided, text/plain will be used.
